stem: About a quarter of Voltmarkt's webshop orders are guest orders with a missing customer ID. How should they be handled in the repeat purchase rate?

options.text: Leave them out of both counts, since they cannot be linked to a customer
Count each guest order as a separate customer, one who has bought only once
Group them as one customer, whose many orders make it a repeat buyer
Count every guest as a repeat buyer, since most guests have bought before
